name: MEGA International Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in 1970 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, MEGA International Development Co.,Ltd. focuses its operations on real estate, encompassing the development, leasing, and sale of residential and commercial properties throughout Taiwan. The company further diversifies its portfolio with interests in the cultural and creative sectors, as well as hotel management. It adopted its current name, MEGA International Development Co.,Ltd., in June 2006, having previously operated as Magic Information Display Technology Corp.
